verified_title: Safe Policy Improvement with Baseline Bootstrapping
metadata_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 1712.06924: Safe Policy Improvement with Baseline Bootstrapping
method_summary: Safe Policy Improvement with Baseline Bootstrapping constrains policy changes at state-actions with insufficient evidence and retains baseline behavior there. Its improvement statements require the stated finite-model, data and uncertainty assumptions.
direct_overlap: safe policy improvement rather than unconditional learned override
evidence_and_limits: General offline RL theory, not a wireless service model. A finite empirical warehouse gate does not inherit a theorem automatically, especially with partial observability, policy-dependent measurements and nonstationarity.
